title: DeathPro
description: A complete Kotlin rewrite of the advanced corpse and ghost mode respawn system.
body:
# 💀 DeathPro Remake
a remake version of https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/deathpro-discontinued.114444/

---

**DeathPro** is a Minecraft server plugin that changes what happens when a player dies by adding custom corpses and a ghost mode.

## **What It Does**
- **Player Corpses**: When a player dies, an NPC corpse is spawned exactly where they died.
- **Ghost Mode**: After dying, the player enters a "Ghost Mode" state where they can fly or walk around as a spirit until they are ready to respawn or recover.

## **Current State & Setup**
**Please Note**: This plugin currently only handles spawning the visual corpse and entering ghost mode. It does not store or lock player items inside the corpse yet, and it does not include custom death messages. These features are planned for future updates.

**To use it, simply drop the jar file into your server's plugins folder and restart the server.**

---

### Commands & Permissions
* `/deathpro` - Main command(Permission: `deathpro.admin`).
* `/deathpro help` - Shows the command helper menu(Permission: `deathpro.admin`).
* `/deathpro reload` - Safely reloads config adjustments (Permission: `deathpro.admin`).
* `/deathpro spawncorpse` - Test-spawn an NPC corpse at your cursor (Permission: `deathpro.admin`).
